# Mytetz

> Mytetz is a learning app. A reader picks a topic from a curated catalogue and studies it in a focused, guided reader.

The catalogue lists topics by title, category, and summary. A reader can search and filter the catalogue, then start a session that opens the topic in the reader.

## Pages

- [Catalogue](https://mytetz.com/): the curated list of topics, and the site's home page.
- [Privacy policy](https://mytetz.com/privacy)
